summary: The filing reports an unregistered sale of equity securities (Class I, S, D shares) by Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S, and provides a monthly distribution declaration and NAV-based total return data. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine capital raise and dividend disclosure by a BDC, not a special-situation event.
